ticket: T47, the cards' pictures (the plan's row S5a)
note: The nine pictures the owner took for now on 2026-10-08, with remarks to come. Each is one of candidates/ (whose manifest has its prompt, settings, job and credits: 18 for all 36), named by the lower case of its card's name in the Card enum. How one was reduced: the candidate is 768 pixels with exactly twelve to a sprite pixel from the corner (checked: every twelve-pixel cell is one colour, and no picture is on a coarser grid), so one pixel was taken from each cell with no smoothing, the picture was cut to what is drawn, and set in the middle of a transparent square of 62 pixels, the smallest that holds the largest (the long arm). All nine are therefore at one scale, a file pixel to a sprite pixel. sheet.png shows them at 1x, 2x and 3x on the cards' paper.
